maya.p: Heads-up — noticed a breadcrumb in the runtime guide that links to a header that no longer exists (staging link below).
maya.p: /docs/runtime/serving#request-routing -> returns 404 fragment on staging, probably an anchor rename.
maya.p: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/serving#request-routing
sam.k: hmm, thanks for flagging. can you paste the exact heading text you see on the page?
maya.p: the current section header is "Routing and fallbacks" (h2), previously it was "Request routing". so anchor changed.
rebecca.l: @sam.k quick question — do we prefer to add an explicit anchor in the heading (<!-- anchor: request-routing -->) or update all incoming links?
sam.k: for now let's add a tiny redirect anchor in the page and then follow up with a sweep to update callers. adding anchor is lower blast radius.
rebecca.l: ok I can do the PR. any volunteers to review? small change, just add HTML comment anchor above the heading.
maya.p: thanks! can you also add a note in the PR description listing the pages that referenced the old anchor? I tracked two: /kb/runbooks/fast-retry and /tutorials/edge-routing.
rebecca.l: will do. opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/245 :tada:
rebecca.l: PR body: "Add compatibility anchor for legacy request-routing links; fixes broken breadcrumb and kb links on staging. Runs npm run build to verify anchors."
sam.k: nice. quick sed if we need to bulk-edit callers later: 

```
rg "#request-routing" -l | xargs -n1 sed -i "s/#request-routing/#routing-and-fallbacks/g"
```

maya.p: :eyes: looks good. rebecca if you want me to run the build and smoke check staging after you merge I can do that.
rebecca.l: please do — would appreciate a sanity check on the breadcrumb behavior too.
docs-bot: deploy-preview build succeeded for PR #245 (staging link: https://staging--pr-245.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/serving) :white_check_mark:
maya.p: checked the preview — breadcrumb now resolves and both kb links land correctly. closing the loop. thanks folks. :rocket:
